db_file.description: Full path to the locate database file.

update_interval.description: Interval (in days) between automatic database updates. Set to 0 to disable scheduled updates.

prune_paths.description: List of directory paths to exclude from the database.

prunefs.description: List of filesystem types to exclude from the database.

nodirs.description: List of specific directory paths to exclude (even if their parent is included). Usually left empty unless fine-grained exclusion is needed.

cron_daily_update.description: Whether to enable daily locate database update via cron.

update_at_boot.description: Whether to update the locate database automatically at system boot.

updatedb_opts.description: Additional options passed to the `updatedb` command. Leave empty or adjust for advanced tuning.
